title: A customer with nothing open on the as-of date is not listed
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, with {Location-A} as your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has no open documents: its only invoice is paid in full.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S1-15 Paid Up.
  • Customer {Customer-B} has one open invoice, created today, and nothing before today.
    For example: {Customer-B} is ZZAUTOTEST S1-15 New Today.
  • Starting screen: A/R Summary (Reports, then "A/R Aging Summary" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu) is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, as opened from the Reports menu.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Look for {Customer-A} and {Customer-B} in the list.
  2. Change the as-of date to yesterday.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: {Customer-A} is not listed, as today, and {Customer-B} is listed.
  • Step 2: the report reloads for yesterday and {Customer-B} is not listed: on yesterday's date it had nothing open.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 5 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11531 (Story 1, Reports open in QuickBooks name order)

  • S1-E1: “A customer with no open documents on the as-of date does not appear, as today.”
  • S1-R1: “A/R Summary opens with customers in name order, A to Z; A/P Summary opens with vendors in name order, A to Z.”
